description: This file contains a class 'ViewsThemeHooks' implementing various hook functions for Drupal views theming, including preprocessing and theme registration logic.

classes.name: ViewsThemeHooks
classes.description: A class implementing hook functions for Drupal views theming, including theme registration, preprocessing for views, nodes, comments, and various view display types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor injecting dependencies such as module handler, path stack, route provider, request stack, config factory, renderer, pager, language, and time services.

methods.name: theme
methods.description: Implements hook_theme() to register theme hooks for views components, dynamically registering theme functions for style plugins and exposing various view-related theme hooks.

methods.name: preprocessNode
methods.description: Preprocesses node templates when nodes are rendered within views, adding view context and handling deprecated variables.

methods.name: preprocessComment
methods.description: Preprocesses comment templates when comments are rendered within views, adding view context and noting deprecations.

methods.name: preprocessViewsView
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for views' main template, setting CSS classes, IDs, and contextual data for rendering.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewFields
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for views' fields templates, preparing field output and attributes.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewGrouping
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for view grouping templates, rendering grouping sets.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewField
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for individual view field templates, rendering field content.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewSummary
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for view summary templates, generating URLs and counts for each row.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewSummaryUnformatted
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for unformatted view summaries, handling row attributes and URLs.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewTable
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for table-style views, organizing rows and columns, sorting, and accessibility attributes.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewGrid
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for grid-style views, organizing items into rows and columns.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewGridResponsive
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for responsive grid views, adding classes and attributes.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewUnformatted
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for unformatted views, adding classes and attributes to rows.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewList
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for list-style views, setting list type and classes.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewRss
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for RSS feed views, setting title, description, and items.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewRowRss
methods.description: Preprocesses individual RSS item variables, setting title, link, description, and elements.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewOpml
methods.description: Preprocesses OPML feed variables, setting title, items, and update time.

methods.name: preprocessViewsViewRowOpml
methods.description: Preprocesses individual OPML item variables, setting attributes.

methods.name: preprocessViewsExposedForm
methods.description: Preprocesses exposed form variables for views, setting labels and descriptions.

methods.name: preprocessViewsMiniPager
methods.description: Preprocesses variables for mini pager templates, setting navigation links and heading levels.
